issues.body: The new note says this function is byte-compatible with the other five presence-only copies, making six total. At this PR head, the same three-argument, two-tuple, presence-only body also exists in `scripts/ledger-identity-watch.py` and `scripts/ratelimit-alert.py`, in addition to the six T1 sites listed by `research/1021-alert-route-consolidation.md`. Thus there are at least eight such copies, and the same false `other five` claim was added to the other two changed headers. This is material to the note's purpose: an implementer using it as the consolidation inventory can omit live trust-plane callers while believing the tier is complete.
issues.fix_hint: Derive and state the current exhaustive inventory/count from the PR-head tree (including ledger-identity-watch.py and ratelimit-alert.py), or avoid a fixed count and link to a checked/generated inventory. Apply the same correction to all three changed DEBT notes.
issues.title: The claimed six-copy presence-only inventory omits current implementations

verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The revised notes correctly remove the nonexistent shared-module claim and describe the return-shape and sparse-checkout hazards, but they introduce an exhaustive count that is already false at this PR head. The tree has additional presence-only `_alert_route` implementations beyond the six claimed, so the documentation still gives a future consolidation author an incomplete inventory. Because round 1 had no findings and this round has a new major finding, progress is regressing.
